game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Mirage Road Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Sand Dunes – Mirage Road, a road of shimmering mirages: the scarab scholar must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Mirage Road: a road of shimmering mirages
core_gameplay_loop: In Mirage Road, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the scarab scholar ahead. Then check the autopsy value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the caravan wagon by solving code steps involving autopsy that move the scarab scholar forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.0).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the caravan wagon first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 5 (applied tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Mirage Road'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how autopsy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against desert bandits in Mirage Road.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.0).
